book.name: 1 KORIN
book.title: Tup ŋendehei ŋaiye Pol nainge nal lenge Korin

content: Ŋoihme ŋaiye pa yisarꞌe ŋimbep me got homboꞌe

Lenge toꞌ tatai ŋam, ŋam masande pa sisyeme bworerme ŋaimune ŋaiye somohon ŋende lenge mwan kaꞌ poi ŋupe ŋaiye tinge jande Moses pe, tinge lalme yarp tuwihme mwahit ŋaiye ki nal yerme tinge, topoꞌe ki samb lenge yaŋah ŋaiye tinge yal, topoꞌe tinge yerŋe Loh Pinip Yaihe.
Ki taꞌe ŋaiye tinge lalme yambaꞌe pinip ŋupe ŋaiye tinge jande Moses ya yoto mwahit topoꞌe loh pinip.

Tinge lalme yono kakah ŋilyeh ŋaiye Yipihinge tikin Got nangang lenge, topoꞌe tinge lalme yonoꞌe pinip ŋilyeh ŋaiye Yipihinge tikin Got nangang lenge. Tinge yonoꞌe pinip ŋeser tikin Got ŋaiye tinge top kin yal pe, ŋeser uku kin Krais.
Kom Got yukur hriphrip me wula tinge. Taꞌe luku pe, tinge yule pe, wahriꞌ tinge ŋanar nalꞌe nalꞌe nato moi gungurar.
Tukwini ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe luku ki taꞌe ŋaiye sasambe, topoꞌe wusyep hraꞌembep natme poi ŋaiye yukur ŋoihmbwaip poi ka tuhur me ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe pupwa tuꞌe ŋaiye tinge yende.
Topoꞌe yukur ya masarꞌe ŋimbep me got homboꞌe taꞌe ŋaiye syeꞌ tinge yende. Wusyep mise tikin Got ŋanange na,

content.text: Lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge jah yarp yono ŋai,
topoꞌe tinge yonoꞌe pinip miꞌe pe, tinge yende wenersep.

content: Poi yukur ya mende niŋ pinip yar tuꞌe syeꞌ tinge ŋaiye yende no, ŋau ilyehe sai uku pe, lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge 23,000 yule.
Poi yukur ya mondolꞌme ŋoihmbwaip ŋumwaiye tikin Lahmborenge tuꞌe ŋaiye syeꞌ tinge yende no, lenge hwaŋ yono lenge pe, tinge yule.
Poi yukur ya mininge wusyep sekete tuhwarme Got tuꞌe ŋaiye syeꞌ tinge yende no, walip hlaꞌ nongomb lenge pe, tinge yule.
Ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe leꞌe ki tas taꞌe ŋaiye sasambe nal lenge syeꞌ pe, tinge yainge wusyep eꞌe yatme poi taꞌe wusyep hraꞌembep no, ya sisyeme na, ŋup eꞌe ŋaiye poi marp pe, ŋup sihei tikin ŋup yuwo.
Lahmende ŋaiye ŋoiheryembe nange kin si gan bongole no, kin tupwaihme hwap pe, kin ka ŋoiheryembe bworerme ŋaiye yukur ka plihe tumbe e oto hwap.

Ŋondolꞌme lalme ŋaiye natme yip pe, yukur ki ŋoinde, ki ŋahilyeh taꞌe ŋaiye ki natme lenge mitiŋ. Kom Got se ka gunde wusyep tupwaiꞌ kitikin pe, yukur ka osme ŋondolꞌme ende ŋaiye ka ondolꞌme yip, ŋaiye ka engelyembe bongol yip, pakai. Ŋaiye ŋondolꞌme ka ondolꞌme yip pe, Got se ka ungwisme yip pe, ka ende yip pa jin bongol no, pa yengelyembe ŋondolꞌme luku.
Yukur ya mahraꞌe naŋ Got topoꞌe yipihinge pupwa
Taꞌe luku pe, lenge toꞌ tatai ŋam, yusme ŋaiye pa yahraꞌe naŋ got homboꞌe.
Wusyep eꞌe ŋaiye ŋam mana yip pe, yip miyeꞌ tuweinge mungwim sai pe, yiyarꞌe wusyep eꞌe ŋaiye ŋam mana yip.

Ŋupe ŋaiye poi da mono ŋai tikin Lahmborenge pe, poi manange wusyep hriphrip, topoꞌe poi misilihme Got ŋaiye ka ende poi ya tongorꞌ mil Krais. Miꞌe pe, poi monoꞌe ŋemwaꞌ taꞌe ŋaiye lenge Korin yonoꞌe pinip wain ŋaiye sai yukoh uku taꞌe ŋaiye wim tikin Lahmborenge ŋaiye nenge poi lalme na gahilyeh. Topoꞌe ŋupe ŋaiye poi moworꞌe kakah no, poi mono pe, luku ki nenge poi gahilyeh taꞌe wahriꞌ tikin Krais.
Kakah sep ilyehe sai pe, poi lalme mono kakah uku. Taꞌe luku pe, poi lalme marp wahriꞌ ilyeh tikin Krais.
Ŋoiheryembe lenge Juta. Yowor ŋaiye tinge yikil ya yanah ŋeser hendeinge no, tinge yende ofa yalme Got pe, tinge yono yuwor uku pe, luku taꞌe ŋaiye tinge jahilyeh topoꞌme Got yal ŋeser hendeinge.

Yip sisyeme wusyep ŋaiye ŋam manange lakai? Yip syeꞌ ŋoiheryembe ŋaiye ŋam manange taꞌe leꞌe, “Ŋai ŋaiye lenge haiten yende ofa me yipihinge pupwa pe, luku ki ŋai bwore mise. Topoꞌe yipihinge pupwa ki bwore mise.” Pakai supule!

Kom ŋam manange taꞌe leꞌe, ŋai ŋaiye tinge yende ofa yanah ŋeser hendeinge lenge haiten pe, luku tinge yende ofa yalme lenge yipihinge pupwa, yukur nalme Got. Pe ŋam gwarnge ŋaiye pa juhilyeh topoꞌe lenge yipihinge pupwa.

Yukur pa yonoꞌe pinip juh yokoh tikin Lahmborenge, topoꞌe pa plihe yonoꞌe pinip juh yokoh tikin yipihinge pupwa. Yukur pa yono ŋai yurp hendeinge tikin Lahmborenge, topoꞌe pa plihe yono ŋai yurp hendeinge tikin yipihinge pupwa.
Taꞌe poi da mende Lahmborenge ka ŋoihmbwaip nihe topoꞌe tuhwarme poi lakai? Topoꞌe poi ŋoiheryembe nange poi bongol mengelyembe kin lakai?
Ya ŋoiheryembe lenge mitiŋ

Ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme ki bwore ŋaiye ya mende, kom yukur ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme luku ka ungwisme poi no, ya murp bwore. Ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme luku ki bwore ŋaiye ya mende, kom ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme yukur ka ungwisme poi Kristen ya murp bongol.
Yukur ya ŋoiheryembe ŋaiye ya mungwisme potopoi, na pakai. Ya mungwisme lenge mitiŋ syeꞌ.
Yuwor lalme ŋaiye tinge yende windau yal luh windau pe, pa yono. Yukur pa ŋoiheryembe wula wula no, pa yisilih yule yut.
Wusyep tikin Got ŋanange na,

content.text: Kekep topoꞌe ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme ŋaiye sai nato kekep pe,

content: Ŋaiye haiten miyeꞌ ende ka isilih nin ŋaiye pa hindi yono ŋai no, nin ŋoiheryembe ŋaiye na el pe, ono ŋai ŋaiye ki yale. Yukur na hiꞌgirnge no, na ŋoiheryembe wula wula ŋaiye na plihe isilih elꞌe ot.

Kom ŋaiye miyeꞌ ende ka ini nin na, “Yuwor eꞌe tinge si yahraꞌe naŋ got homboꞌe” pe, yukur na ono yuwor uku. Detale, na ŋoiheryembe wusyep ŋaiye miyeꞌ uku ŋana nin pe, yukur na ende yumbune ŋoihmbwaip bwore kin.

Ŋam yukur ŋoiheryembe nin, ŋam ŋoiheryembe lenge mitiŋ syeꞌ. Ŋaiye miyeꞌ ende yukur ka ininge wusyep ende me ŋai pe, ni tatame na ono ŋai ŋaiye ni sande. Yukur na gunde ŋoihmbwaip miyeꞌ ende me ŋaimune ŋaiye kin hiꞌgarnge ŋaiye ka ono.
Ŋaiye ŋam si manange wusyep hriphrip malme Got me ŋai ŋaiye ŋam da mono pe, detaꞌe la ŋai ti ka jonome ŋam nange ŋam mende pupwa?
Taꞌe luku pe, ŋai ŋaiye na ono, lakai pinip ŋaiye na onoꞌe, lakai ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe ŋaiye na ende pe, ende ŋaiye na ahraꞌe naŋ tikin Got.
Ŋoiheryembe lenge Juta, topoꞌe lenge haiten, topoꞌe lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge tikin Got, ŋaiye yukur na ende ŋainde pupwa no, na ende tinge ka tumbe yi yoto hwap.
Yende tuꞌe ŋaiye ŋam mende. Ŋam mende ŋaiye tinge ka lalme hriphrip me ŋaimune ŋaiye ŋam mende. Ŋam yukur ŋoiheryembe ŋam, pakai. Ŋam ŋoiheryembe tinge lalme nange Lahmborenge ka ungwisme tinge.
